description: rebaseWhen defaults to 'auto', which resolves to 'behind-base-branch' whenever automerge is enabled.
That made every push to main force-rebase all open Renovate branches, restarting their CI. Each
merged PR pushes twice to main (the merge itself, plus the 'chore: update Helm chart' commit from
release.yml), so the whole queue was invalidated twice per merge. Renovate also stops processing a
run after a single automerge because the base branch SHA changed, so branches rarely stayed green
long enough for the next run to merge them, and major updates (sorted last) starved indefinitely.
'conflicted' rebases only when a branch actually conflicts with main, which keeps passing checks
typescript-eslint hard-errors on startup under TypeScript 7 ('typescript-eslint does not
support TS 7.0'), and its peer range is typescript '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0'. That peer conflict also
makes npm refuse to resolve the tree, so Renovate cannot even regenerate package-lock.json --
PR #450 failed with 'Artifact update problem' for exactly this reason. The app itself is TS 7
clean (tsc -b, vite build and the full vitest suite all pass), so the only thing holding us at
6.x is lint. Drop this cap once typescript-eslint ships TS >=7.1 support:
